reader_notes: Overall the Swedish is idiomatic and well-controlled; register is right for a kulturredaktör essay and the fäbod vocabulary is glossed where needed.

Friction: in paragraph 4 'de tillfälliga brukarna i trakten' arrives in the definite form with no prior mention of any 'tillfälliga brukare'. A reader has to reconstruct the category on the fly. It resolves, and Q2 option C reuses the same phrase so the item is still answerable, but the definite article promises an antecedent the text never gave.

Ohlander's counter-argument sentence ('tar då ... det som var ett tecken på engagemang för dess orsak') is compressed; the meaning (mistaking a sign of commitment for its cause) is recoverable but needs a second pass.
Q1's correct option packs three conditions (brukad dalgård + yngre brukare + rovdjursstöd) - all three are present in the first paragraph, so it is defensible, but it is a long option to verify.

Q3 option D is attractive because both of its clauses about naturvärde and umbäranden are supported; it only fails on the appended judgement that abandonment was 'riktigt', which the text never endorses. Fair discrimination, but it rests on a single trailing clause.
Nice touch that Halvardsson concedes the sample was not random and answers Ohlander partially rather than fully - the disagreement reads as real rather than staged.
